description: Réseau de bus navette urbaine Pornic is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vincent PODEUR. Le réseau de la navette urbaine de Pornic mis en place en 2024 se compose d'une ligne reliant les bourgs de Sainte-Marie-sur-Mer et Le Clion-sur-Mer à Pornic. Elle fonctionne toute l'année de 7h à 20h en semaine. Coverage: Vincent PODEUR. The publisher named on the listing is Vincent PODEUR. Its keywords include bus, reseaux-de-transport, transport-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
